objective: Improve geometric-mean DOM and On-Demand JSON parsing throughput across frozen mixed corpora at simdjson 8e6bac94 while preserving exact event hashes, malformed-input errors, the full relevant upstream test set, and peak RSS.

meta.provenance: Pinned public source simdjson/simdjson@8e6bac94877f2d3d026000d36ce81e0aaf38d26f; upstream jsonexamples plus deterministic generated JSON; current-head A-A qReference construction is frozen after local calibration.

sourceDetails.mutableSurface: src/generic parsing kernels and architecture implementation translation units; public headers, evaluator, build files, benchmark harness, tests, fixtures, and expected hashes are protected
sourceDetails.upstreamHarness: hone/verify.cpp trusted event harness (parent-timed; no self-reported throughput consumed)

measurement.platform: native linux/amd64 on Deckbox (AMD Ryzen 9 7900, Docker Engine 29.1.3, cgroup v2)
measurement.q: geometric mean over the three frozen corpora of the per-workload candidate/reference speed ratio for full-document DOM and On-Demand parses; each workload ratio is the geometric mean of back-to-back reference/candidate wall-time PAIRS (paired-geomean, lead alternated so sustained host contention cancels within each pair), wall measured in the trusted evaluator parent around the non-self-reporting harness, the reference parser rebuilt from frozen trusted sources in the same eval and timed adjacently; never a self-reported number from candidate-linked code. Timed iterations are BOTH byte- and structure-distinct: the trusted parser-independent harness rotates value bytes AND relocates insignificant whitespace across a sampled subset of structural tokens before every iteration after the first, so no two timed iterations share their bytes OR their stage-1 structural index (a resident-index replay is caught), and every perturbed iteration's full event stream is folded into a chain the parent validates against the trusted reference's chain at the same iteration count.
measurement.peakRssGate: candidate whole-tree peak RSS <= per-split frozen baseline (protected asset) * 1.05, measured as the kernel-owned cgroup2 memory.peak of a fresh per-launch leaf the candidate subtree joins before the privilege drop (not VmHWM of a single pid, which a detached child or clear_refs can dodge)
measurement.validationOracle: expected event hashes and RSS baselines live only in the protected asset mount (assets/<split>/expected.json), outside the candidate-readable workspace and corpus; perturbed-iteration chains are pinned per iteration count by the trusted reference binary within each eval; each candidate launch runs in a fresh SysV-IPC namespace and candidate-writable residue (/tmp, /var/tmp, /dev/shm, SysV IPC) is purged between launches so no parse result or resident index can bridge launches

normalization.status: final native linux/amd64 rebaseline from five A-A samples under the accepted frozen evaluator contract
